units.source_text: “秀男，”父亲改变了语气，“佐田先生的大作可不同啊！

en.t: “Hideo,” his father said, changing his tone, “Mr. Sada’s masterpiece is something quite different!

units.source_text: 这是佐田先生在峨嵯尼姑庵隐居时画出来的画稿，是非卖品。”

en.t: This is a sketch Mr. Sada painted while living in seclusion at a nunnery in Saga, and it is not for sale.”
